facts.summary: FDA urged a second Phase 3 before NDA submission, delaying approval to 2028 · Phase 3 · brilaroxazine in schizophrenia · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The FDA informed the Company that it strongly encouraged the Company to conduct, prior to submission of an NDA, an additional Phase 3 trial that will be similar in design to the successfully completed RECOVER Phase 3 trial
evidence.program_discontinued: The Company indicated to the FDA that it will conduct a Phase 3 study incorporating this feedback before submitting an NDA.
